build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a two-ball physics puzzle scene with ramps and walls
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with configurable size and placement
update_task_relationships: define a TOUCHING spatial relationship goal between two bodies in the PHYRE task
skip_template_params: raise SkipTemplateParams to exclude invalid parameter combinations from the PHYRE task template
